text_block_list.name: Previously on
text_block_list.text:
Previously on! Kiseki,
a horsegirl who super loves manga,
meets a trainer captivated by her running.

text_block_list.name: Previously on
text_block_list.text:
And so,
she invited him to watch her run in a mock
race!

text_block_list.name: Previously on
text_block_list.text:
And so,
she invited her to watch her run in a mock
race!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Quite the lineup gathered here...
We've got Satono Crown, 3rd in the Derby,
as well as this year's debut prodigy,
Satono Diamond...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the young lady of the Satono family
isn't the only one to watch.
Vivlos is also widely seen as a strong
contender on the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Haaah...! What a truly
awe-inspiring lineup of competitors...!!
Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine!
My eyes have been wide open since last
night...! Sure, I'm a bit anxious,
but I've been thrilled this whole time,
too!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This situation feels just like a manga
cliffhanger... Doesn't it get you hyped?
"Will Kiseki overcome these formidable rivals
and secure a trainer contract!?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, I want to see you become ...
...Yeah, I want to see you become ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called by the starter official,
Kiseki heads to
her gate position alongside the other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hushed silence falls over the track—
and the gates fly open!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd favorites,
Satono Diamond and company,
keep a close eye on each other
from the rear,
testing the waters as fellow closing stretch
specialists.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is currently running in second-to-last
place.
...She's way in the back.
Did she get off to a slow start?

text_block_list.name: Mid-tier Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like an uncontracted girl is
running too.
Pretty rough positioning, though... Heh,
only the young run without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said it herself—
she wants to 'thrill people with her
running.' If so,
she must have a strategy in mind to topple
these formidable rivals.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(The ones ahead of me are all fierce sprinters
with crazy late-stage bursts...!
Going conventional and taking a front spot
would just trigger a textbook defeat!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(In that case,
catching them off guard with the unexpected
is my only shot! Rattle the favorites,
find the opening...
and script the protagonist's victory!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Bet it all on this one strike!
—Time to trigger the ultimate comeback
flag!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Resolute determination blazes in Kiseki's
eyes.
Her gaze locks onto...
the narrow gap between the two runners
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A late-stretch showdown!
I'll burst right through the middle while
they check each other!
Shake 'em up and take the win before they
can react! ...HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Break through, me!
Kick off a double-page color spread level
climax! And then—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (And... then...?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (H-Huh...? What—?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
C-Catch up! Pass them! I can do this,
come on!!
HAAAAAH......... HYAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...8th place...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki couldn't join the fight among the
leaders and faded back.
...She failed to make any remarkable
impression.
choice_data_list: (Still, I should at least praise h...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
T-This wasn't how it was supposed to go...
If I'm the protagonist,
I was supposed to win. Win, and then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Dammit......!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*......... *gasp*—
After begging so hard just to get into this
mock race...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I knew there was a gap in our abilities.
Still,
I pleaded relentlessly just to make this
race happen...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Because I thought I could show you.
I wanted to show you!
Me, being the main character in the most
exciting race ever...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(To you... the one who got hyped for me.
The one who became my reader...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, there was no comeback,
nothing at all,
just a toootally booor-ing race...!
I couldn't give you any thrills at all—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Grrrghhh... dammit... I'm so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the bitter frustration etched
on her face after the mock race,
I run all over the academy,
desperate to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True,
she didn't get a flashy moment in the
spotlight this time.
But that determination to challenge a stronger
opponent beforehand—
choice_data_list: (I know she has what it takes to b...
(I know you have what it takes to ...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll have our rematch in three weeks!
Looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking out the window,
I saw Kiseki bowing earnestly to the girls
she had just raced today. And then,
her eyes lit up with excitement—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Now,
all that's left is to go back to
Trainer...
choice_data_list: Kiseki! What was that you were jus...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Perfect timing, Trainer!
I've got a rematch set up!
Will you come watch again?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I'll definitely make it an exciting race!
I'm gonna win and become the protagonist of
this story!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if the protagonist doesn't make a move,
the story never starts!
If I don't chase my dream,
there's no victory waiting at the finish
line!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't just sit around moping!
A manga protagonist has to get their revenge
arc!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know I have what it takes...
to become a true protagonist...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is surely going to show us something
"exciting" again.
Another spectacle that keeps the audience
on the edge of their seats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because you can't help but root for her.
You want to see her running take shape—
you want to witness that moment.

text_block_list.name: Trainers Appearing O...
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you let me help you?!"
"Please, let me lend you a hand!"
